notes.title: v1.01 Patch (March 28th)
notes.content:
The following issues have been addressed and fixed as of the current update:

- Fixed the issue where the controls get fixated to 1P (keyboard) upon accepting a network invitation from outside of the network mode. Now, upon entering the network mode via a friend's invitation, the controls will be determined by the key pressed at the first prompt.

- Fixed issues where players experience desynchronizations in network battles.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
